m2_definition.definition: A current rights-cleared typed Prakas 77 assignment release, complete for its declared jurisdiction, level and time scope, retains six-digit strings, Khmer/Latin names, source row identity, edition, validity and exact artifact digests. Require reproducible full-row reconciliation against the primary legal artifact, independently licensed point/area geometry, CRS/topology validation, administrative crosswalk review, civic-address/building-link review and privacy/licence/provenance review. Publish approved immutable data artifacts and verify the actual AGID loader/API. Administrative code equality does not prove postal identity or official boundary equality; derived/virtual/none stay explicit, do not replace the required licensed geometry and cannot infer premises or buildings.

definition_basis: The existing Cambodia runtime Promotion section requires exact typed Prakas artifacts or verified transformations, immutable digests, validity, independently licensed point/area geometry, CRS/topology, administrative crosswalks, civic/building links and privacy/licence review. Name the missing M2 stage without relaxing those gates, M1_metadata or any of the nine hard blockers.

manual_source_exception.finding: The Latin district label aligns but the CSV postal code differs from the visible primary PDF postal code; the CSV code duplicates another district observation. No source value is automatically corrected.

rights_review.review: Dataset metadata says cc-by-sa with a generic licence URL; the site footer/terms name CC BY-SA 4.0. Terms also restrict commercial gain beyond cost recovery and defer to third-party terms. Record the unresolved scope/precedence rather than infer either an unrestricted upstream PDF grant or a blanket reuse ban. The separate law record says notspecified; its copyright flag is not proof of public-domain status. Review exact artifact rights, attribution, modifications and share-alike obligations before publication.

quality_rules: The grain is a typed source table observation, not a validated current assignment. Keep postal strings and leading zeroes. Never derive a postal code from numeric administrative keys.

Measure all active rows of all six captured CSV files, retaining source ordinals. Report fully blank padding records separately from missing fields in active records. Identical labelled-language resources are aliases, not twice the coverage.

Report duplicates and administrative-key/postal-prefix disagreements as diagnostics. Only comparison against the exact primary PDF can confirm a transcription conflict; never automatically repair or reject legitimate code changes.

The primary PDF is image-only in the reviewed digest. Record selected full-page visual review, not a claim of full row reconciliation or national temporal validity. Source effective date, metadata edit time, HTTP modified time and retrieval time stay separate.

Require strict public CKAN package/resource identity and bounded CSV schema. Hash actual bytes with SHA-256; opaque publisher hashes and metadata sizes are not trusted integrity evidence. Repeat metadata and a CSV download without calling it an atomic release.
Persist no raw CSV/PDF/HTML, place rows, addresses, customers, owners or property records. No geometry generation, MLMUPC query, credentials, paid compute or new publication destination is used.
